$howToUse: Every sprite the app can draw is declared here by a stable key. The renderer only ever asks for keys.
A sprite gets its pixels from one of three source kinds, and can switch between them at any time without touching app code:
sheet     - one cell lifted straight out of a vendor sheet
composite - a kitbash: several cells stacked with offsets, flips, and tints
file      - a hand-authored PNG in assets/sprites/authored/
Start everything as composite. When a component can't be kitbashed convincingly, draw it and flip that
one entry to 'file'. Nothing else changes. That is the whole migration path.
THEME KEYS: tokens starting with @ bake as reserved key colors and are swapped per room at draw time.
Use them for anything that should take on the room's color. Use literal tokens (copper, silk, ok, warn,
fault) for anything that must look identical in every room.
Run `npm run assets:bake` after editing. It writes assets/atlas/ and then the purity validator checks it.
To pick cell coordinates, render a ruled contact sheet first — never guess:
